newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield America units top turnover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield America units top turnover.

text.p: Units in Westfield America Trust topped turnover in mid-afternoon trade on the Australian Stock Exchange on Tuesday with 19.46 million shares or about three percent of the trust's issued capital traded.

The bulk of the trade was through SBC Warburg and Macintosh Securities. SBC Warburg specialled parcels of six million, five million and two lots of two million units, all at A$1.05 per unit. Macintosh specialled one line of two million and crossed another line of two million, also at A$1.05.
A spokesman for Westfield Holdings Ltd, which holds 49.1 percent of Westfield America along with the Lowy family, said movements amoung institutional holdings were responsible for the volume.
"It's just institutions moving in and out," the spokesman told Reuters.
"You've got some who are taking profits and others who see the improved state of the American retail market which has come through in the last couple of months," he said.
Westfield America listed at its issue price of A$1.00 on July 3. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800
